summary: Verified 'Two ways to start.' tiles centering fix on EZtoFind.ca home page. On desktop (1440px) the two cards (hn-tile-search, hn-tile-valuation) are horizontally centered as a group with equal left/right gaps (330px each). Each card is capped at 380px width (not stretched). On mobile (390px) cards stack full-width (358px each) with no horizontal overflow. Fix works as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1440px measurements: container [data-testid=hn-tiles] full width 1440, searchLeft=330, valRight=1110, leftGap=330, rightGap=330 (perfectly centered, within 0px). Cards: searchWidth=380, valWidth=380. Mobile 390px: stacked=true (valTop 1447 > searchBottom), widths 358px, docScrollWidth==docClientWidth (no overflow). Note: The element carrying data-testid='hn-tiles' has className 'hn-section' in DOM but centering works via inner grid.
rca of the issue: N/A - CSS centering fix verified working. Container uses grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,380px)) with justify-content:center on desktop, and 1fr with justify-content:stretch inside @media (max-width:960px) for mobile stacking.
